notes.title: 个人独立开发4年，2.5D横版ACT动作肉鸽游戏《勇者试炼传》，免费试玩版上架Steam。
notes.notes:
Trial of the Brave is an action-style Rogue game. Players can control different types of powerful characters. Each character has its own skill combos, and there are nearly a hundred types of effect card attributes that can be matched to create various genre effects. .
【Battle system】
There are currently 4 characters in the game (more characters will be updated in the future). Each character has 4 different skills and basic attack, block, teleport and retreat.
You can pick up props during the battle. Defeating the BOSS will reward you with cards with attribute bonuses. Study the skills of various characters, match talents with attribute cards, and deal explosive damage.

Perfect Block: See through the enemy's attack and block at the moment of the enemy's attack. It is regarded as a perfect block and you can block and counterattack.

Perfect teleportation: Avoiding enemy attacks will trigger bullet time.
